title: Tanvi Sharma Reaches Korea Masters Quarterfinals, Sets Up All-Indian Clash
indian_angle: Young Indian talent Tanvi Sharma has advanced to the quarterfinals of the Korea Masters, setting up an exciting all-Indian clash against Rakshitha Sree Ramraj.
summary: Tanvi Sharma defeated Shriyanshi Valishetty to secure her spot in the Korea Masters 2026 quarterfinals, where she will compete against fellow Indian player Rakshitha Sree Ramraj.

title: India Rushes World Championships Venue Overhaul for August 17 Start
indian_angle: India is making extensive efforts to ensure the Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium is fully prepared to host the BWF World Championships for the first time in 17 years.
summary: The BWF is overseeing a massive overhaul of the Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium in New Delhi to address previous issues and ensure operational readiness for the World Championships, which India will host from August 17-23.

title: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy's Shoulder Cleared, Coach Cautious Ahead of Worlds
indian_angle: The fitness of star doubles player Satwiksairaj Rankireddy is crucial for India's medal hopes at the upcoming home World Championships.
summary: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy has received a green light for his shoulder after rehab, but his coach remains cautious, emphasizing the need for continued focus as the top men's doubles pair prepares to anchor India's campaign at the World Championships.

title: Ayush Shetty to Face Defending Champion Shi Yuqi in World Championships Opener
indian_angle: Young Indian shuttler Ayush Shetty faces a tough challenge against the defending champion in his opening match at the home World Championships, alongside other Indian contenders.
summary: Ayush Shetty is set to play defending champion Shi Yuqi in the first round of the BWF World Championships in New Delhi. PV Sindhu will face Sophia Nobel and Lakshya Sen will play Collins Filimon.

title: Player Eligibility Announced for World Junior Championships 2026
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has released the eligibility criteria for Indian players aiming to compete in the prestigious World Junior Championships in Cairo.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has issued a circular detailing the player eligibility requirements for selection to the BWF World Junior Championships 2026, scheduled to be held in Cairo, Egypt.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system will directly impact the development and competition experience for young Indian badminton players in national events.
summary: Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.
